newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Fipe inflation at 0.5 pct - Fipe.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Fipe inflation at 0.5 pct - Fipe.

text.p: Brazil's inflation as measured by the Economic Research Institute (Fipe) was 0.5 percent between April 8 and May 7, down from 0.64 percent in the previous four-week period, a Fipe official said.
Juarez Rizzieri, president of Fipe, said a decline in food prices slowed the price index, which measures costs in the city of Sao Paulo.
Food prices fell 0.91 percent in the period.
Rizzieri said he expected the May Fipe index to be between 0.3 and 0.5 percent.
He gave the following breakdown of the Fipe weighted index for the period.
- Food -0.91 pct fall in the period
The Fipe index is calculated by the University of Sao Paulo, which releases inflation figures at weekly intervals.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
